description_of_position: A mysterious elven rogue who serves as the Black Market's most trusted fence, known for moving stolen artifacts without asking questions. They grew up on the streets while their noble-born cousins attended academy, so they developed an eye for assessing value others miss.
reason_for_being_there: Recently, Eldrin has been frequenting the Broken Wheel Tavern hoping to find rare shadow-touched items for a private collector. The patrons have noticed them studying newcomers with unusual intensity.
distinctive_feature_or_mannerism: Eldrin absentmindedly twists a silver ring on their left hand, occasionally muttering in Sylvan as they inspect goods.
character_secret: Eldrin secretly hopes that by acquiring shadow-touched artifacts, they will locate their missing sibling who disappeared into the Shadowfell years ago.
read_aloud_description: A tall elf with sharp features and haunted silver eyes, dressed in dark leather that has seen countless adventures. Their movements are calculated, predatory.
roleplaying_tips: Speak in measured, careful tones with occasional Sylvan phrases. Pepper their speech with market metaphors like 'that's a buyer's market.'
